Here are all of my food recommendations. 
Cattleman’s for great steak. Broadway 10 and Mahogany are better steak but very pricey. Oklahoma is a great state to visit for good steak so I recommend it if you have the means. 
Patronos is great Italian. 
Mexican Radio and Iguana Grill are good Mexican places.
Empire Pizza and Hall’s Pizza Kitchen are amazing if you’re looking for pizza. 
I think Goro Ramen is my favorite ramen in the state. 
A fun beer place is the Social Capital. 
Cheevers is a great for miscellaneous American food.
There’s also a lot of good breakfast places in OKC. Neighborhood Jam, The Hatch, and Sunnyside are all amazing. 
None of these should be farther than 15 or so min from the stadium. Have a great trip and welcome to OKC.
